provenance.purpose: Seed replication of the hard-negative arm. Seed 7 -> 123 for BOTH the enrichment-block draw and training, matching the protocol used for the 3B scale-up replication.
provenance.init: the SAME 3B prose-native pilot as the published balanced run, so the lineage forks at exactly one point
provenance.balance: four (gold x net-sign) cells hold 852 pairs each; the pure/mixed marker is 300 per cell, so neither polarity nor edit shape is predictive of gold
provenance.CAVEAT_crossvul: CrossVul non-held-out pairs are training data, as in every balanced run in this repository.
